hook.say: Think you know the United States? Name these five states from their outlines alone. The last one is sneaky!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Texas is the largest of the 48 contiguous states.
questions.sayAnswer: Texas! It is the largest of the 48 contiguous states.

questions.fact: Florida has the longest coastline of the 48 contiguous states.
questions.sayAnswer: Florida! It has the longest coastline of the 48 contiguous states.

questions.fact: California has more people than any other US state.
questions.sayAnswer: California! It has more people than any other US state.

questions.fact: Michigan touches 4 of the 5 Great Lakes and looks like a mitten.
questions.sayAnswer: Michigan! It touches 4 of the 5 Great Lakes, and it looks like a mitten.

questions.fact: Louisiana is the only US state divided into parishes instead of counties.
questions.sayAnswer: Louisiana! It is the only US state divided into parishes instead of counties.
